scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
other_conditions: Must be a regularly appointed faculty member in institutions covered under UGC Act with NAAC accreditation, deemed universities, fully funded institutions, or institutions of national importance.
Must be 50 years of age or younger.
Must have at least 10 years of service remaining in the university from date of application.
Must have supervised Ph.D. dissertations of five full-time candidates.
Must have completed at least two sponsored research projects funded by national/international government or private agencies.
Proof of being a single girl child must be submitted via affidavit on a ₹100 stamp paper attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar.
benefits_summary: Provides a research grant of up to ₹10,00,000 for a tenure of 2 years, disbursed in three installments.
documents_required: affidavit on ₹100 stamp paper attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar
